data.name: Alshifa
data.gender_notes: Alshifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who heals or grants relief. The name Alshifa carries the meaning “Healer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alshifa usually hope their child will grow to embody healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the healing power of Allah (God) and the ability to bring comfort and consolation to those in need
data.etymology: Alshifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alshifa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: الشفاء
in_arabic.meaning: هو الاسم الذي يعني الشفاء من الأمراض
in_arabic.long_meaning: الشفاء هو اسم من أصل عربي يعني الشفاء من الأمراض والخداع والمعانقة، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى، وهو اسم يستخدم في الإسلام للوصف للشخص الذي يحتاج إلى الشفاء من الأمراض الجسدية أو الروحية، ويُعتبر اسمًا ذو معنىً جميلًا في الإسلام، حيث يحتوي على المعنى الديني والروحي، ويُستخدم أيضًا في الأسماء الإسلامية لتسمية الأطفال، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى التي تذكر في القرآن الكريم، ويُعتبر اسمًا ذو تأثيرٍ كبيرٍ في الإسلام، حيث يُعتبر رمزًا للشفاء والخلاص من الأذى وال вред، ويُعتبر اسمًا ذو أهميةٍ كبيرةٍ في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: الشفاء
in_urdu.meaning: وہ نام جو بیماریاں سے شفاء کا نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الشفاء اسم ہے جو عربی زبان کا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے بیماریاں سے شفاء، اس کا تعلق اسلام سے ہے اور یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ہے جو قرآنی ناموں میں ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بہت مشہور ہے اور یہ نام صرف بیماریاں سے شفاء کے لیے نہیں بلکہ روحانی طور پر بھی شفاء کا نام ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے، اور یہ نام اپنے مذہبی و ثقافتی حوالے سے بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: अलशिफा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम बीमारियों से शफाई का नाम है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलशिफा नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है बीमारियों से शफाई, यह नाम इस्लाम से जुड़ा हुआ है और यह एक पवित्र नाम है, जो कुरान में उल्लिखित है, इस्लामी परंपरा में यह नाम बहुत पवित्र माना जाता है, यह नाम न केवल शारीरिक रूप से बल्कि आत्मिक रूप से भी शफाई का प्रतीक है, यह नाम मुसलमानों के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, और यह नाम अपने धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व के लिए जाना जाता है

in_english.name: Alshifa
in_english.meaning: This name means healing or recovering from diseases
in_english.long_meaning: Alshifa is an Arabic name that means healing or recovering from diseases. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quran. In Islamic culture, this name is associated with spiritual healing and recovery, not just physical. It is a name that is highly revered in Islamic tradition and is considered a blessing. The name Alshifa is derived from the Arabic root 'š-f-' which means to heal or to recover. In Islamic tradition, this name is considered a symbol of healing and recovery from spiritual and physical ailments. It is a name that is highly valued in Islamic culture and is often given to children born with health issues or to those who are in need of spiritual healing

data.cultural_impact: The name "Alshifa", meaning "healer" in Arabic, has significant cultural implications in the Islamic world. Healing not only refers to physical ailments, but also encompasses emotional and spiritual well-being. The importance of healing is emphasized in Islamic teachings, as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is reported to have said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." Thus, acts of healing and providing relief to others are considered noble and meritorious, earnening blessings both in this world and the next. Additionally, the concept of Alshifa has further artistic and literary expressions, as evidenced in the works of classical Islamic poets and calligraphers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Alshifa", from a spiritual perspective, represents the power of divine mercy and compassion. It is a reminder of Allah's infinite ability to heal and cure, whether it is in response to our supplications or as part of His eternal plan. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Allah the Exalted said: 'I am as my slave thinks I am, and I am with him if he remembers Me. If he forgets Me I forget him.'" Thus, by invoking the name Alshifa, one is not only calling upon the healing power of Allah, but also seeking closeness to Him through remembrance and devotion. In this sense, the name becomes a powerful reminder of the deep spiritual connection between the individual and the Divine, and a source of comfort and solace in times of need.
